info.name: Nash AI Functions Store Locations API
Set the day capacity for a store location

items.docs: Set the delivery capacity for a store location on a specific date. Overrides the default weekly capacity for that particular day.

info.name: Set the weekly default capacity for a store location

items.docs: Configure the default weekly capacity schedule for a store location. Defines how many orders the location can handle per day of the week.

params.name: size
params.description: The size of the store locations to return.

params.name: offset
params.description: The offset of the store locations to return.

items.docs: List store locations for the organization with pagination. Use size and offset parameters to paginate through results.
Create a new store location (pickup point) with address, hours, and capacity settings.

info.name: Get store locations that cover specified location (latitude & longitude, city_zipcode)

params.name: latitude
params.description: The latitude of the location to check coverage for. If used, must specify longitude

params.name: longitude
params.description: The longitude of the location to check coverage for. If used, must specify latitude

params.name: cityZipcode
params.description: The city_zipcode pair to check coverage for. The location must have coverage set up using the `City & Zip Code` unique field, not the separate `City` or `Zip Code` fields.

params.name: zipcode
params.description: The zipcode to check coverage for.

items.docs: Find store locations whose delivery zones cover a given geographic point. Provide latitude/longitude, city_zipcode, or zipcode to find matching store locations.

info.name: Create or update store location by external identifier

items.docs: Create a new store location or update an existing one using your external identifier. If a store location with the given external identifier exists, it is updated.

info.name: Get store location by external identifier

items.docs: Retrieve a store location using your external identifier instead of the Nash store location ID.
Create a new store location or update an existing one. Matches on external identifier or store location ID for upsert logic.
Create or update multiple store locations in a single request. Each store location is matched by external identifier for upsert logic.
Retrieve a single store location by ID, including its address, hours, capacity, and zone associations.
Update an existing store location's details such as address, hours, or capacity. Only provided fields are updated.
Delete a store location by ID. Orders referencing this store location will no longer have a valid pickup point.
